c74object.name: bachmcp.gui.params
c74object.digest: Parameter panel for a bach-mcp algorithm
c74object.description: The panel of an algorithm's parameters (v8ui), which builds itself from the file the runner loads: one card per parameter (slider, range, toggle, menu, seed, curve, list), plus the runner's options. Connect a runner's panel outlet to it and its outlet back to the runner. It is saved with the patch, and works with pattr and pattrstorage when given a scripting name.

inlet.digest: From a runner's panel outlet; reset, bang, clear, autosize, set_name

outlet.digest: To the runner: param, bypass, repeat, snap, source_mode, capture, write_to_playground

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: Shown while no algorithm is loaded, like set_name.

method.name: reset
method.description: Sets every parameter to its declared value. Double-clicking a control does this for one.

method.name: bang
method.description: Sends the current value of every parameter.

method.name: autosize
method.description: 1 (default): the panel resizes itself to its content.

method.name: set_name
method.description: Drawn while no algorithm is loaded.
